review.tagline: Agent skill that turns prompts into HTML prototypes, decks, animations and infographics
review.summary: A skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other skills-compatible agents, installed with `npx skills add alchaincyf/huashu-design`. It produces single-file HTML prototypes, HTML slide decks exportable to editable PPTX, timeline animations exported as MP4/GIF, infographics and 5-dimension design reviews. It adds a brand-asset protocol and a library of 60 HTML-native styles.
review.audience: Developers using coding agents to produce design deliverables without a GUI tool
strengths: Works across skills-compatible agents: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes
Exports HTML decks to PPTX with real editable text boxes via html2pptx.js
Core render and export pipeline runs locally; cloud features are optional, in scripts/cloud/
Brand protocol extracts colors from official assets and writes brand-spec.md
weaknesses: Output is HTML; no layer-level export to Figma or Keynote
3D, physics and particle animation are out of scope
README says quality drops to 60-65 of 100 with no brand context
skills CLI 1.5.15 and older installs only SKILL.md, missing subdirectories
needs: Models: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes
